name: Youform Free
free_limit: Hosted form builder free forever: unlimited forms, questions and text submissions subject to fair use; one user, conditional logic, signatures, webhooks and integrations, uploads up to 10 MB per file, plus 25 video/audio responses per organization each month.
watch_out: Fair-use restrictions apply and sustained excessive use can prompt an upgrade request. Free retains Youform branding; custom domains, payment collection, advanced analytics, partial submissions and additional team seats require paid plans. Video/audio recordings are capped at 25 responses per organization monthly; text submissions have no published monthly cap. Third-party integrations may have separate costs.
